full_judgment: 02. Material facts leading to this Rule are that the petitioner along with 2 other as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit no. 05 of 2001 in the 2nd Court of Joint District Judge, Faridpur impleading the opposite-party nos. 4-13 as defendants for declaration of title of 12 annas share and also for declaration that the Land Acquisition Case no. 56(9)/58-59 in respect of acquisition of schedule land is illegal, ineffective, void and not binding upon them. Eventually, after hearing learned Judge by the judgment and decree dated 21.09.2006 decreed the suit on contest against defendant nos.1-6 herein opposite party nos. 4-9 and ex-parte against others. Against which Title Appeal no. 66 of 2007 is now pending for hearing in the Court of Special District Judge, Faridpur.
